responsibility: This file implements GCC’s sparse bitmap container behind bitmap.h, a core utility used by many analyses and optimizers to represent sets of integers such as SSA properties, dataflow facts, and register/live-range information. It owns bitmap element allocation and recycling for both obstack and GGC-backed bitmaps, supports the internal linked-list and tree representations and conversion between them, implements the substantive set/query/update/iteration/debug-printing routines, tracks per-bitmap memory statistics, and includes CHECKING_P selftests for key bitmap operations.
same_name_distinction: Contains the executable sparse-bitmap implementation: element allocation/free lists, list/tree representation management, set/query/update operations, debugging/statistics support, and selftests. In contrast, gcc/bitmap.h defines the bitmap data structures, iterator macros, and lightweight wrapper/view APIs.
